Name: Xtardew Core
Author: hixega
Description:
[b]WIP NEXUS PAGE
[/b]
This mod provides an event framework and in the future may do more for some Xtardew-related mods.

Now updated for Stardew Valley 1.6!

Note: this is currently only a requirement for the Xtardew Female - Sexperimental Edition mod.

[b]Event commands:
[/b][list]
[*]clothesOff - undress farmer
[*]clothesOn - dress farmer
[/list][b]Event tokens:
[/b][list]
[*]Dressed - Indicates whether the player is currently dressed ("true", "false")
[*]Undressed - Indicates whether the player is currently undressed ("true", "false")
[/list]
This mod is not overly useful alone unless you want those commands to events :)
